notes: Planning envelopes only. These values are not live supplier quotes and are not vehicle-specific facts.

fuelEconomyKmPerL.rationale: Bounded compact-to-SUV planning envelope informed by published Japanese vehicle fuel-economy tables; replace with a vehicle-specific value when known.

fuelPriceJPYPerL.rationale: Bounded planning envelope for regular gasoline; refresh against the official weekly retail-price series when a dated quote is required.
fuelPriceJPYPerL.source: Agency for Natural Resources and Energy petroleum price statistics

compact.rationale: Bounded compact-class planning estimate; location, season, tax, and supplier availability can change the quote.
compact.source: Toyota Rent a Car published price-list reference

standard.rationale: Bounded standard-class planning estimate; not a live reservation quote.
standard.source: Toyota Rent a Car published price-list reference

suv.rationale: Bounded SUV-class planning estimate; not a live reservation quote.
suv.source: Toyota Rent a Car published price-list reference
